summary.text: Kathryn Waters is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 125, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Joe Kerwin (R).
According to Ballotpedia, she is an attorney; in a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has practiced law for 30 years and has lived in the district for more than 50 years.

paragraphs.text: Kathryn Waters graduated from Central Dauphin High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maryland, College Park in 1991 and a law degree from Widener University Commonwealth Law School in 1995, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her first job as an attorney was as a deputy district attorney in Dauphin County, and that she was the first Black female deputy district attorney there.
Waters advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary, and she listed the Dauphin County Democratic Committee as endorsing her campaign.

In the survey, she said she wants better education and services for district residents, believes healthcare is a right, and supports a moratorium on building data centers until their effects can be studied.
